notes.summary: Actual BJ general-variety theory constructs the genuine mixed E1 operator with raw mass V, finite dual-energy target condition, comparison and uniqueness. Singular arbitrary-support existence remains conditional on EP.
notes.detailedSummary: The retained field is algebraically closed, trivially valued and characteristic zero; X is reduced irreducible projective, possibly nonnormal, and the global source theory permits every ample line bundle and ample real numerical Cartier class. Relative integral closure preserves the prescribed generic fiber. Mixed intersection measures, weighted decreasing continuity, exact energy normalization, integrability/dual-energy equivalence, domination and one-constant uniqueness precede envelopes. Actual BJ12.8 gives EP/surjectivity/completeness equivalence; its smooth sufficient theorem does not prove singular EP. Compactness, differentiation, bounded-J integration and attainment are kept conditional at their actual envelope uses.
notes.text:
Primary-source partial theorem, independently reconstructed from BJ1801.08229v4. Let k be algebraically closed, trivially valued, characteristic zero, X reduced irreducible projective of dimension n, and omega an ample real numerical Cartier class, including c1(L) for every ample L. Put V=(omega^n)>0. The source's conventions permit nonnormal X; Sections 7--12 return to general varieties. A configuration is closed integrally in its prescribed generic fiber, rather than absolutely normalized. Its vertical component E has DVR multiplicity b_E=ord_E(t) and point v_E=b_E^-1 ord_E on k(X). The genuine mixed raw model measure is sum_E b_E product_i((omega_i,model+D_i)|E) delta_vE. Nefness makes the weights nonnegative and the central-fiber cycle gives total mass (omega_1...omega_n). Component multiplicities are not discarded.

The compactified symmetric intersection pairing extends by decreasing model majorants, is finite on mixed E1 tuples and extends multilinearly to differences. For genuine algebraic PL tests h, integral h M_raw is the pairing with first entry (0,h). Its positive sup-norm bounded functional extends by PL density and Radon representation. Thus this is the model/intersection operator, not an inverse measure construction. Energy is E_omega(phi)=pairing((omega,phi)^(n+1))/((n+1)V), E(0)=0, E(phi+c)=E(phi)+c, and E1 consists of genuine global PSH with E>minus infinity. Probability MA is raw MA/V. BJ7.19 gives model agreement, exact mass, integrability and decreasing continuity; weighted7.21 uses the pairing containing the test minus the pairing containing zero. Printed sign slips are corrected by this multilinear identity.

Strict-max locality assigns the measure of the winning potential on {phi>psi}. Weighted7.21 justifies the discontinuous limit in7.40. Equal mass gives integral_{phi<psi} MA(psi)<=integral_{phi<psi} MA(phi). The energy difference is the average of the n+1 mixed integrals of phi-psi divided by V. Mixed negativity gives I>=0 and J comparable to I. BJ10.4 separates zero I using finite-dual-energy divisorial tests and divisorial order determination; on irreducible X equal measures therefore imply one additive real constant. Global domination10.6 is also available before EP, but only for genuine global potentials.

For a raw positive Radon target nu the required mass is precisely V. With mu=nu/V the exact finite-energy condition is E^vee_omega(mu)=sup_{psi in E1}(E_omega(psi)-integral psi dmu)<infinity. BJ9.20 equates this with integrability of every E1 potential. A decreasing convex weighted sum of normalized bounded-J potentials would contradict integrability if their target integrals were unbounded below. The mixed expansion I(t psi,0)<=t[1-(1-t)^n]I(psi,0)<=n t^2 I(psi,0) gives the scaling estimate needed for finite dual energy. Actual MA targets satisfy the condition by mixed integrability and the tangent energy inequality. Measures have arbitrary support; no single skeleton is imposed.

Under genuine EP, Theorem5.11 supplies normalized PSH compactness,8.5 the two-sided PL energy derivative and its continuous-test extension,9.19 bounded-J target L1 convergence, and energy usc variational attainment. Applying both f and -f to the attained objective yields the actual equation. The raw translation-invariant objective is VE-integral phi dnu. Target completeness and the MA embedding give strong E1 completeness after surjectivity; conversely increasing model maxima and completeness recover envelopes. These are actual general-variety12.8 statements, not the smooth sufficient12.9/5.20. The original singular equation remains unproved without singular EP. For n=0, X=Spec k, V=1 and E(c)=c, so the one-point equation is immediate.

notes.summary: A reconstructed rational strict-G/curve/model/FS bridge works on singular projective spaces. BE5.16/5.17 and exact Laurent Gauss cutoff give algebraic PL descent without an auxiliary descending generic class; compact local extensions and ample principal collars follow.
notes.detailedSummary: For an actual globally glued continuous ample rational metric with finite rational affine selections and corrected relative contact minorants, Ducros's compact strict polytope theorem supplies admissible branch domains before GR curve detection. Analytic curve maps retain analytic units, and a common skeleton gives nonnegative outgoing slopes including zero/type I/IV cases. Represented residue nefness, GM formal gluing/local-to-global and BE7.8 then give genuine CPSH over a finite Laurent field; exact global section coefficient cutoff descends it to trivial k. Any represented rational model function is exactly a same-class pure FS difference after cancelling a metric on aH_K-M. This yields compact local algebraic PL extension. Independent section localization on original nonnormal X supplies actual ample principal-open nested collars, and BJ rational lattice operations supply subordinate partitions. Rational local data do not establish arbitrary real slope approximation or singular EP.
notes.text:
Independent unverified proof drafts with actual primary hypotheses checked. The local rational class used here consists of finite continuous selections of finitely many rational affine formulas in regular log norms, every formula finite on its stated neighborhood. At an infinite coordinate its coefficient is zero. The corrected relative contact condition is f(t')>=ell(t')+C near t with f(t)=ell(t)+C; the same C occurs in both assertions. This auxiliary class does not redefine genuine global PSH.

On a compact strict Laurent domain over finite K=k((varpi)), finitely many retained coordinates are analytic units. Published Ducros3.2, with actual valued-field image1.2, gives a finite rational polytope image and dimension at most the analytic dimension. Refine by every branch-equality hyperplane. On a connected relative cell different affine values stay separated, so a continuous finite selection is locally constant in its chosen value group and hence fixed; continuity extends it to the closure. Closure preimages are finite strict Laurent domains after clearing slopes/constants into monomials and parameter powers. The finite closed cover is admissible: near a point discard the finitely many domains not containing it. Thus actual strict-G Q-PL membership is established before any model criterion. No printed CLD dimension equality is needed, and a constant moment has dimension zero.

For every smooth analytic curve map over Omega=completion of an algebraic closure of K, retain analytic units after local algebraicity of the source curve; the map and pulled units need not be algebraic. Thuillier2.2.24/2.3.20 factor all unit logs through one finite semistable skeleton and give harmonic balancing. A continuous finite affine selection is lisse after finitely many edge intersections, including real breakpoints. Subtract the harmonic contact minorant: each outgoing derivative of the difference is nonnegative and the harmonic weighted sum vanishes. The lisse Laplacian is therefore nonnegative. Zero/identically-zero coordinates are discarded under the finite-affine convention; type I/IV unit-log germs are locally constant. Affinoid boundary slopes are not tested on the curve open. Thuillier3.4.4 gives subharmonicity. Wanner Section4 is used only after smooth proper compactification, on the original open.

Now let an actual globally continuous metric on ample rational B over projective singular X have these local presentations. On its finite strict cover an integer tensor power of weight is log|a_i|; the actual frame a_i e_i^N has norm one and norm-one transition cocycles define the same bundle metric. GM2.10 supplies the formal model. Actual GR5.1/5.4 detect residue nefness through every smooth analytic curve map; GJR7.1/7.6 give local nef model detection and GM3.11 global nefness. GM Lemma3.3 detects nefness back on an already represented K-model. GM2.6 and projective domination2.4 represent it algebraically on a projective model, retaining its generic fiber. BE1805.01016v3 Theorem7.8 applies over nontrivial K with ample B and general-variety scope: perturb the represented nef bundle toward an ample model of the same generic bundle with epsilon decreasing to zero, obtaining uniform genuine FS approximation. This avoids smooth-only BJ4.19. CLD17.8.4 is nef-to-psh for strict integer PL;18.8.4 is the represented integer-PL residual-degree/current equivalence, and18.8.6 permits complete extension for a represented positive metric. GR Remark1.8's warning about a general R-PL positive-current converse/pullback is respected.

Exact Gauss descent uses an independent variable T of radius exp(-1/q), not evaluation at an element of H(x). For a global generating FS system s_j on mB_K, H0 base change gives Laurent expansions s_j=sum_r varpi^r f_jr with f_jr in H0(X,mB). Canonical trivial-reference section norms are at most one by proper centers. The Gauss value is (1/m)max_{j,r}(log||f_jr||+lambda_j-r/q). Its finite continuous value on compact X has a lower bound b; all r>R terms fall uniformly below b and can be removed exactly. Retained sections globally generate, since a common zero would force minus infinity at a closed k-point. Hence each FS metric descends exactly, preserving rational weights, uniform errors and decreasing limits. Coefficients are never expanded over Omega.

For an arbitrary rational model function F_K on O_XK, BE5.14 and5.16(vi), with whole proofs LF1989--2033, express F_K=psi-psi' by taking any ample model A and sufficiently large r so rA+B and rA are relatively globally generated after suitable multiples. Their common generic class M need not descend. Choose fixed ample H/k and a large integer a with aH_K-M ample. BE5.17, LF2036--2043, adds a pure FS metric tau on that class to both expressions; product sections put both final metrics on aH_K and tau cancels. Expand only those final H0 sections by the preceding Gauss construction. Their exact rational FS difference is actual BJ algebraic PL. No equivariance of the initial K-model, descending generic class for A, or positivity of an FS difference is assumed. This removes the extra GM4.12 generic-class gate.

For a finite rational local selection f near compact C inside U, construct compact rational-domain neighborhoods W with C inside int W and W inside U. Its pullback is actual strict Q-PL, hence an actual formal trivial-bundle metric after tensoring. GM2.7 extends that metric globally over X_K. Algebraize and apply exact model-function descent: a global BJ PL function agrees exactly with f near C. Agreement on all U is not asserted.

The collars themselves are algebraic on the original reduced nonnormal X. Start with a very ample standard open D(s). Invert only constrained functions whose values at x are nonzero. Section localization gives f_i=tau_i/s^d_i; a=s product_i tau_i cuts out exactly the localized open D(a). The localization identity follows by clearing powers locally on a finite affine cover and gluing, without normalization. Clear all constraint numerators by one a^m; add a complete very ample system whose ratios generate k[D(a)]. A rational negative floor and rational upper bounds strictly containing x produce v, compact Q={v<=0} inside U, and P={v<=-epsilon} inside int Q. If v is divided by dm, constraint thresholds remain C_j inside the numerator, not dm C_j. Complete generators prove compactness. Finally rational global PL density and clipping give chi_i=min(1,max(0,2p_i-1/2)), equal to one on compact shrinkings and supported inside U_i; rho_i=min(chi_i,1-sum_{j<i}rho_j) is a nonnegative subordinate PL partition summing to one. There is no variable denominator.

notes.summary: The rational common-collar draft constructs bounded local mixed products, weighted compatibility, compact IBP and exact raw mass; model atoms give domination. Compact perturbations prove the Rossi application and moving collars give controlled already-regularizable damping, with weak-input gates retained.
notes.detailedSummary: Using n1's genuine pairing and n2's metric/extension/partition bridge, one common rational FS collar represents an entire bounded decreasing tuple and its tests. The exact formulas theta=omega+ddc p, Phi=Psi/A+p and G=v-p+(M+1)/A retain the reference and scalar. Weighted BJ continuity gives overlap/approximation independence and compact IBP; summing the subordinate PL partition yields ddc1=0 and raw mass V. Correct winning-locus comparison and independent divisorial determination then permit positive-model-atom domination without a singular Dirac equation. Known smooth EP gives smooth local/global equality via continuous-majorant nets. The compact-perturbation bridge gives uniform actual affine FS approximation with floors and algebra generators, sufficient for the Rossi contradiction. Moving compact collars are globally decreasing also on new annuli and supply controlled damping only for already regularizable inputs. Full weak trace, removable extension and Runge induction remain unproved.
notes.text:
Unverified rational bounded-local proof draft using n1 and n2. A local input is an usc generically finite decreasing sequence limit of continuous corrected contact rational selections on a common neighborhood. It is not every weak psh input. For a bounded finite mixed tuple and its bounded tests choose one ample collar Q={v<=0}, P={v<=-epsilon}, common bound M, theta=omega+ddc p, and rational A with A epsilon>2M+1. Put h=Av+M+1. On P, h<-M. On the compact boundary strip v>=-1/(2A), h>=M+1/2. Nested closed sets {u_ij>=h} have empty intersection, so one entire tail satisfies the strict boundary inequality, without Dini for a discontinuous limit. Globally set Psi_ij=max(u_ij-h,0) on Q and zero outside. Its metric weight is max(u_ij-M-1,Av) and it equals the reference on a whole collar; n2 makes it genuine global CPSH. Its bounded decreasing limit is genuine E1.

Set Phi_i=Psi_i/A+p and G=v-p+(M+1)/A. On P, u_i/A=Phi_i+G and ddc G=omega, hence ddc u_i=A(omega+ddc Phi_i). The local mixed product is A^n times the genuine mixed global product restricted to int P. Continuous terms agree with the actual continuous model/CLD product, retaining graded residual degrees, multiplicities and defects. For fixed collar data the limiting truncations max(u_i-h,0) are explicit and independent of approximants. To compare two collars, shrink inside both inner domains, use a third common collar, and restrict each sequence to it; continuous locality followed by global decreasing continuity gives the same explicit limiting truncation and measure. Thus these are compatible genuine products, not a proxy inverse operator.

For bounded test u_0j=A Phi_0j+AG use BJ7.21 for Phi_0j and fixed continuous G with compact cutoffs. Signed PL factors are differences of same-class genuine ample FS metrics, so weighted convergence handles them termwise. Compact local PL extensions from n2 and symmetric global pairings give integral g ddc f1...ddc fn=integral f1 ddc g ddc f2...ddc fn. A cutoff equal to one near supp g confines all signed measures there; weighted limits extend the identity to bounded decreasing local inputs. CLD8.7.2 is used only for locally uniform continuous convergence, not for this bounded discontinuous passage.

For bounded globally locally L-psh phi write T=omega+ddc phi, T0=omega and S=sum_{j=0}^{n-1}T^j T0^(n-1-j). With n2's subordinate global rational PL partition rho_i, compact IBP gives integral rho_i(T^n-T0^n)=integral phi ddc rho_i S. Apply the identity to local psh weights phi+g_i and g_i for the same reference and subtract. Each signed measure is supported in its chart and all weighted integrals are finite. Overlap compatibility and multilinearity give sum_i ddc rho_i S=ddc1 S=0. Thus total raw mass is exactly V; mixed mass is the corresponding intersection number. Dimension zero is treated separately. A common inner collar transfers max locality with the winning measure; mass gives comparison. Divisorial order determination follows by comparing genuine global truncations on divisorial points inside Q and their common zero values outside, applying BJ4.22 and recovering the original weights on P.

BJ2.12/2.33 put an ample test bundle on a relative-integrally-closed flag-ideal model realizing each source-convention divisorial v_E. Its actual weight b_E(L_model|E)^n is positive, giving a bounded genuine test b without EP or a Dirac equation. For bounded phi<=psi MA(psi)-a.e., translate b below phi and put phi_t=(1-t)phi+t b for rational t>0. Comparison and equal mass give full MA(phi_t) mass to {phi_t<psi}; mixed positivity supplies an atom at the tested divisorial point of size at least t^n MA(b). Hence phi_t(x)<psi(x); let t decrease to zero and use order determination. Known smooth EP then gives smooth bounded local/global equality: use decreasing directed continuous-majorant nets, envelope contact orthogonality and this domination. Continuous genuine envelope metrics lie in the local rational decreasing class by uniform FS approximation, rational rounding and error shifts. No metrizability or majorant sequence is assumed. Nef actual pullback references are approached by adding rational ample references and genuine class closure.

For an actual affine FS function b, clear positive rational slopes into powers, add original affine generators at dominated low weights, and take the closed projective embedding. Its hyperplane chart is exactly Y and b is the weight of an ample rational reference. A continuous corrected contact rational v equal to b off compact K extends as the same metric near the boundary. n2 makes it genuine CPSH. Uniform global FS approximation converts to actual affine FS by taking high very ample multiples and adding complete sections, the constant branch and original generators at low weights. A basepoint-free system alone is not asserted to embed Y. Uniform error remains uniform on the whole noncompact chart after subtracting the same reference; shifts 2epsilon_j with 3epsilon_(j+1)<=epsilon_j give a decreasing sequence.

This suffices for Rossi's arbitrary relatively compact analytic neighborhood V: finite separating polynomials and generator bounds make a compact polytope P containing the polynomial hull and excluding the bad boundary set. Its affine FS exhaustion u vanishes on P and is positive on that set. An integer C gives Cu>log|f|-t on the entire boundary and hence a whole winning collar. The function Cu outside V and max(Cu,log|f|-t) inside is a continuous contact rational compact perturbation, including zeros of f. An affine FS approximant with error below one third of its positive value at the hull point separates that point from the original compact set, contradicting the defining polynomial-hull inequalities. This proves that continuous Rossi application without arbitrary weak affine regularization.

For an already supplied affine FS sequence u_j decreasing to u<=g with g>=1 an actual exhaustion, choose C_r tending negatively to minus infinity and R_r increasing with R_r>2-C_r. On compact Q_r={g<=R_r}, nested closed-set emptiness gives increasing j_r with u_jr<g+1. The genuine global collar potentials phi_r=max(u_jr-2g,C_r) on Q_r, constant outside, decrease on the old sublevel, on the new annulus because u_jr-2g<1-g<C_(r-1), and outside by their floors. Their limit is u-2g. Uniform rational FS errors epsilon_r=4^-r and shifts B_r=2 sum_{i>=r}epsilon_i give decreasing H_r and actual affine w_r=H_r+2g<=2g+sup H_1. This explicit annular check replaces an invalid diagonal monotonicity claim.

For an already regularizable v on Y_f with v<=g, let g_c=max(g,-(c/3)log|f|). It is an actual FS exhaustion with f^-1 among the generators. Controlled w_i satisfy w_i+c log|f|<=max(2g+c log|f|,(c/3)log|f|)+B. Floors D_i yield continuous contact rational functions b_i on Y, constant near Z(f), decreasing and bounded by one affine exhaustion h. The single-function moving collar makes psi_i=b_i-2h genuine globally psh; psi_i<=-h gives a whole constant boundary collar for eta_i=max(psi_i,-i). Uniform FS approximation and summable shifts then give an actual affine FS sequence for the damped function. This is an already-regularizable implication, not weak-input identification.

notes.text:
Exact disposition: unchanged original P16.1 remains unproved. The target still includes every reduced irreducible geometrically unibranch projective variety over every algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field, every dimension and every ample line bundle, with raw target mass V and arbitrary-support finite dual energy. n1 supplies the already genuine real ample-class global operator and uniqueness, with existence conditional on EP. n2 and n3 give new rational representation, exact PL extension, local mass, compact perturbation and controlled already-regularizable proof drafts. Their local rational scope does not replace the full target.

The indispensable unresolved gates are explicit. First, complete upper-growth affine regularization for every smooth weak input through a resolved proper witness, nef pullback class and actual section/generator conversion, then controlled principal-open removable extension; varying c_i log|f| is not globally monotone and requires the actual upper-envelope/usc closure theorem. Second, construct Wu6.12 Step2's open weak trace before radial Step3. Third, reconstruct every weak split-piece, finite local-projection, Hartogs/Runge and singular-stratum induction use in6.14--6.16 and6.3--6.5. Continuous integer trace must be localized, and gamma=1 treated without division by gamma-1. A Hartogs radius formula for an already Runge domain cannot prove the domain is Runge. Fourth, establish the countable rational singular EP base: the actual Wu7.1 proof explicitly invokes weak/global6.5. Only then can cardinality and real-class EP passages, onto normalization and unconditional two-sided envelope differentiation/variational attainment close the original equation. Neither the global operator nor strict concavity supplies this envelope base.

The separate trace and localization checks in the argument are not replacements for those gates. Finite-flat determinant traces retain all Artinian fiber dimensions and actual FS floors/generators; tensoring local factors proves weighted trace base change independently of regularization. On normalized smooth curve slices a unit-root coordinate gives t=c y^e; target/source Gauss points have actual fiber dimension e and their radial limits prove the center trace equality, including minus infinity. Global FS tests determine fixed normalized slicing weights before choosing a line adapted to a weak birational witness. This only identifies a previously constructed open trace extension. Pole localization uses divisor orders on the finite normalization: a(-ord h)_+<=c ord f, then h^p f^q integral for q/p>c/a and one f-power conductor makes its powers regular. Hull tests give the 2cM bound; denominator counting fails for f=z^2,h=z^-1.

For geometrically unibranch X, normalization q is finite birational degree one with singleton geometric fibers and identical residue fields in characteristic zero; q^an is a homeomorphism. Unconditionally pullback preserves genuine PSH and energy, and q_* mixed MA(q*phi_i)=mixed MA(phi_i), by actual model projection and decreasing pairings. Onto PSH/E1 and equal dual-energy target sets are separate: BJ Lemma5.13 requires approaching larger classes with EP. Topology does not establish that analytic antecedent. The explicit nodal obstruction outside unibranchness is retained: a degree-d nef blowup model on P1 has raw d delta_ord(p1), central degrees 0,d and endpoint values 0,d at the two node preimages; downstairs pullbacks would have equal values, contradicting upstairs uniqueness. It is not a counterexample on the retained unibranch domain.
